subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should OpenClaw accept this currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result field and retry classified empty server_error turns before assistant failover for #97877?
rationale: The code shape appears sound, but the remaining questions are compatibility, session/message-delivery risk, proof sufficiency, and which open candidate PR should become canonical.
